mergedParams.userDescription: Clean line wipe reveal. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Clean Line Wipe Reveal with Internal Effects

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'LineWipeReveal' that animates a clean horizontal line wipe reveal effect using clip-path animations. The effect should accept parameters for direction (left/right/up/down), duration (default 0.8s), and line thickness (default 2px). Use generic AnimationRange to animate clipPath from 'inset(0 100% 0 0)' to 'inset(0 0 0 0)' for left-to-right reveal. Include a subtle leading edge glow by combining two effects - the clip-path reveal and a temporary box-shadow that follows the reveal edge. The effect should target components via targetIds array and use ease-out easing for a smooth deceleration.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect type using AnimationRange[]. Effect data: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 0.8, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: ['inset(0 100% 0 0)', 'inset(0 0 0 0)'], prog: [0, 1] }] }. Secondary glow effect with box-shadow animation. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), direction: z.enum(['left', 'right', 'up', 'down']), duration: z.number().optional(), lineThickness: z.number().optional() }). Return format: { effects: [clipPathEffect, glowEffect] }.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'DiagonalWipeReveal' internal effect preset that creates a diagonal line wipe from corner to corner. Implement using CSS mask-image with a linear gradient that animates its position. Accept params for angle (default 45deg), duration (default 1s), and blur amount for soft edge (0-20px, default 5px). The gradient should animate from 'linear-gradient(45deg, black 0%, black 50%, transparent 50%, transparent 100%)' with mask-position moving diagonally. Add a subtle brightness boost that precedes the reveal edge by 100ms to create anticipation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with mask animation. Primary effect: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'maskImage', val: generateGradientMask(params.angle), prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }, { key: 'maskPosition', val: ['-100% -100%', '0% 0%', '100% 100%'], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }] }. Brightness pre-effect with offset timing. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Params: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), angle: z.number().default(45), duration: z.number().default(1), blurAmount: z.number().min(0).max(20).default(5) }). Returns combined effects array.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'CircularWipeReveal' internal effect that reveals content with an expanding circular mask from center or custom origin point. Use CSS radial-gradient as mask-image, animating from 'radial-gradient(circle at center, black 0%, transparent 0%)' to full reveal. Parameters include origin (centerX%, centerY%), duration (default 1.2s), and easing curve. Combine with a subtle scale effect (0.95 to 1) during the first 30% of the animation for depth. The circular edge should have a feathered transition using gradient stops.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect using radial-gradient mask. Main effect: { type: 'generic', start: params.delay || 0, duration: params.duration || 1.2, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, easing: params.easing || 'ease-out', ranges: [{ key: 'maskImage', val: generateRadialMask(params.originX, params.originY), prog: [0, 0.3, 0.6, 1] }] }. Scale effect: { type: 'generic', duration: params.duration * 0.3, ranges: [{ key: 'scale', val: [0.95, 1], prog: [0, 1] }] }. Input: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), originX: z.number().default(50), originY: z.number().default(50), duration: z.number(), easing: z.string() }). Return: { effects: [maskEffect, scaleEffect] }.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'WaveformLineWipe' audio-reactive internal effect preset that synchronizes the line wipe reveal with audio beats. The wipe speed accelerates on bass hits and the line thickness pulses with the waveform. Base the reveal on waveform data with sensitivity controls. The effect should use a combination of clip-path for the wipe and transform scaleY for the line thickness pulse. Include threshold settings to trigger acceleration only on significant beats.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Waveform effect type with audio reactivity. Primary effect: { type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 2, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, props: { type: 'translate', audio: 'bass', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 0.7, threshold: params.threshold || 0.5, direction: 'horizontal' } }. Combined with generic clip-path effect modulated by audio data. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { hooks: ['useWaveformData'] } }. Params: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), sensitivity: z.number().min(0).max(1), threshold: z.number().min(0).max(1), duration: z.number() }). Returns audio-reactive effect array.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'MultiLineWipe' internal effect preset that creates a venetian blind style reveal with multiple horizontal lines wiping in sequence. Each line should have a slight delay offset creating a cascade effect. Accept parameters for line count (3-20, default 5), stagger delay (default 0.05s), direction (top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top), and total duration. Use clip-path with multiple inset regions or leverage CSS linear-gradient masks with multiple color stops.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with staggered animations. Generate array of effects per line: lines.map((line, i) => ({ type: 'generic', start: i * params.staggerDelay, duration: params.lineDuration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`${targetId}-line-${i}`], ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generateLineClipPath(i, params.lineCount, params.direction), prog: [0, 1] }] })). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Input: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), lineCount: z.number().min(3).max(20).default(5), staggerDelay: z.number().default(0.05), direction: z.enum(['top-bottom', 'bottom-top']), totalDuration: z.number() }). Returns array of staggered line effects.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'GradientWipeReveal' internal effect that reveals content with a soft gradient edge rather than a hard line. The gradient width should be customizable (10-200px) and the wipe can include color tinting at the edge. Implement using mask-image with a moving linear-gradient that has multiple stops for the soft edge. Add optional color overlay that fades as the wipe passes. Parameters include gradient width, edge color, direction, and blur intensity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with gradient mask animation. Primary: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'maskImage', val: generateSoftGradient(params.gradientWidth, params.direction), prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'maskPosition', val: calculateMaskPositions(params.direction), prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }] }. Color overlay effect with synchronized timing. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Params: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), gradientWidth: z.number().min(10).max(200), edgeColor: z.string().optional(), direction: z.enum(['left', 'right', 'up', 'down']), blurIntensity: z.number() }). Return: { effects: [maskEffect, colorEffect] }.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'SplitLineWipe' internal effect preset where the content is revealed by two lines moving from center outward (or inward to center). The split can be horizontal or vertical with customizable gap width between the lines. Each half should support independent timing offsets and easing curves. Use clip-path with polygon or dual inset values to create the split effect. Include optional rotation parameter to create angled splits.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with dual clip-path animations. Top/left half: { type: 'generic', start: params.offset || 0, duration: params.duration / 2, targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: ['polygon(0 0, 50% 0, 50% 100%, 0 100%)', 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%)'], prog: [0, 1] }] }. Bottom/right half with similar structure. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Input: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), split: z.enum(['horizontal', 'vertical']), gapWidth: z.number().default(0), direction: z.enum(['outward', 'inward']), rotation: z.number().optional(), duration: z.number() }). Returns array with both half effects.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'RevealWithTrail' internal effect that creates a line wipe with a motion trail effect behind it. The trail should fade and blur over time, creating a sense of motion blur. Implement using multiple overlapping effects - the main clip-path reveal, a secondary semi-transparent trail element, and a blur filter that increases along the trail. Accept parameters for trail length, fade duration, blur amount, and main wipe speed.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Combined generic effects with trail generation. Main reveal: { type: 'generic', duration: params.duration, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generateWipePath(params.direction), prog: [0, 1] }] }. Trail effects array with decreasing opacity and increasing blur: generateTrailEffects(params.trailLength, params.fadeRate). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Params: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), trailLength: z.number().min(3).max(10), fadeRate: z.number().min(0).max(1), blurAmount: z.number(), direction: z.string(), duration: z.number() }). Returns main effect plus trail effects array.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'PixelatedLineWipe' internal effect preset that reveals content with a pixelated/digital line wipe effect. The line should consist of small blocks that reveal in a staggered pattern, creating a digital glitch aesthetic. Use CSS grid-based masking or multiple small clip-path regions. Include parameters for pixel size (4-32px), randomization amount for stagger, and glitch intensity. Add optional color aberration at the wipe edge.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with pixelated mask generation. Create grid of pixel effects: generatePixelGrid(params.pixelSize).map(pixel => ({ type: 'generic', start: pixel.delay, duration: params.pixelDuration, targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: pixel.clipPath, prog: [0, 1] }] })). Glitch effects with random offsets. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Input: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), pixelSize: z.number().min(4).max(32), randomization: z.number().min(0).max(1), glitchIntensity: z.number(), aberration: z.boolean().optional(), duration: z.number() }). Returns array of pixel reveal effects.

prompts.prompt: Create an 'ElasticLineWipe' internal effect preset with spring physics simulation for the wipe motion. The line should overshoot slightly and bounce back, creating an elastic feel. Implement using spring easing with customizable tension and friction parameters. The effect should combine clip-path for the reveal with a subtle skew transform at the leading edge to emphasize the elastic motion. Include parameters for spring config, overshoot amount, and bounce count.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with spring easing physics. Main effect: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1.5, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, easing: 'spring', springConfig: { tension: params.tension || 180, friction: params.friction || 12 }, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generateSpringPath(params.overshoot), prog: [0, 0.6, 0.8, 0.9, 1] }] }. Skew effect for elasticity: { type: 'generic', ranges: [{ key: 'transform', val: generateSkewValues(params.bounceCount), prog: [0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8, 1] }] }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Params: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), tension: z.number().min(1).max(500), friction: z.number().min(1).max(50), overshoot: z.number(), bounceCount: z.number().min(1).max(5), duration: z.number() }). Return: { effects: [clipEffect, skewEffect] }.
